propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiter (token bucket per user, enabled per-admin) returns 429 responses that rebar treats as hard failures instead of honouring Retry-After headers
_with_connection_retry is the single choke point for all 15 transport call sites including mutations like create_issue, and retrying 429s there would reintroduce duplicate-issue failures
429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only via a per-call opt-in defaulting OFF, never reaching mutations because 429 can arrive after the server begins a write

Retry-After header handling must reuse existing _errors.parse_retry_after and MAX_BACKOFF_S, apply jitter first then clamp to 60s ceiling per Atlassian guidance, and never raise raw JIRAError past the adapter boundary

transport.py at 789 lines against locked 800-line cap leaves insufficient headroom for 429 policy implementation, forcing extraction of retry/error cluster to new adapters/jira_datacenter/retry.py module
Cap exhaustion on 429 retries must raise BackendHTTPError with code=429, never a raw JIRAError, to preserve the existing vendor-type sealing contract
